stem.text: A lead sphere is released from rest at point X, a long way above the surface of a planet. The sphere falls in a vacuum. After a time of $4.0\,\text{s}$, it has fallen through a vertical distance of $3.0\,\text{m}$. Assume the acceleration of free fall is constant.
How far will the sphere have fallen from point X at a time of $20\,\text{s}$ after its release?
